summary: Iteration 6 testing PASSED end-to-end for both backend and frontend. Backend: 8/8 pytest tests pass in /app/backend/tests/test_iteration6.py — announcement serializer exposes players[], max_players=4, slots_left, is_full, is_member, is_author correctly; author is auto-joined on create; POST /announcements/{id}/join is idempotent, decrements slots_left and flips is_member=true; a 5th join returns 409 'Match complet (4 joueurs)'; POST /announcements/{id}/leave from the author returns 400; leave/join on a non-existent id returns 404; regression on /clubs, /messages/unread_count, /auth/me still 200. Frontend (mobile viewport 375×667): (A) SUBSCRIBED marc@padel.fr — Club Annonces shows all 5 level-filter chips (level-filter-Tous/Débutant/Intermédiaire/Confirmé/Expert), the match panel renders players avatars + empty slots + 'X/4 · N place(s)' text, the green 'Match confirmé · 4/4' badge appears on the seeded 4/4 annonce (2 occurrences on the club), 'Rejoindre le match' → 'Quitter le match' → 'Rejoindre le match' round-trip works via ann-join-<id>/ann-leave-<id> and hits the correct backend endpoints, composer shows ann-post-btn (no ann-premium-lock, no blur overlay). (B) SUBSCRIBED manage-subscription — tapping premium-card on /profile routes to /manage-subscription (NOT /paywall); the screen renders 'Premium actif', 'PadelConnect Premium · 9,90 €/an', renewal-date='14 août 2026', 'Renouvellement automatique: Activé', 'Géré via: TEST_STORE', and manage-cancel-btn 'Gérer / Résilier l'abonnement'. (C) NON-SUBSCRIBED FreeUser<ts> — profile shows 'Passe Premium' and premium-card routes to /paywall; club Annonces overlays the BlurView with '6 matchs en attente de joueurs' + 'Passer Premium · 9,90 €/an' (blur-premium-btn) which routes to /paywall; composer shows ann-premium-lock 'Passe Premium pour poster une annonce' which also routes to /paywall; ann-post-btn is hidden; level-filter chips remain visible above the blur. Regression from iter5 still holds (chat-premium-lock for non-sub, Test Store price $79.99 expected per iter5 note, clubs list + Liste/Carte toggle still fine).

issues: 'Géré via' shows raw 'TEST_STORE' string on the RC Test Store — the mapping only rewrites APP_STORE/PLAY_STORE/RC_BILLING. Not a user-facing bug in production, but the label is ugly in the test env; consider adding a case for 'TEST_STORE' → 'Test Store'.

critical_code_review_comments: backend/server.py serialize_announcement (line 353-375) is correct: default player_ids fallback to [author_id] handles legacy (pre-iter6 seeded) documents gracefully.
backend/server.py join endpoint (line 408-421) is idempotent and returns 409 only when count >= 4 AND user isn't already in — good ordering.
backend/server.py leave endpoint (line 423-433) correctly forbids the author (400) BEFORE mutating.
club/[id].tsx toggleJoin (line 72-80) routes non-subscribers to /paywall before hitting the API — good defensive gating.
club/[id].tsx blur overlay (line 297-310) is only rendered when filtered.length > 0 which means the '6 matchs en attente' count adapts to the level filter; that's a nice UX detail.

manage-subscription.tsx correctly reads customerInfo.entitlements.active['pro'].expirationDate / willRenew / store, and falls back to the App Store / Google Play sub-management URL when managementURL is missing.
profile.tsx premium-card branch `router.push(isSubscribed ? '/manage-subscription' : '/paywall')` — verified BOTH branches.
